limitations: The 8-bit and 16-bit checks are sampled and cannot establish exhaustive full-width equivalence.
The registered 20-family benchmark is bounded and is not a universal measure of meaning or general intelligence.
Structural family holdout does not establish raw operand or pretraining disjointness.
Hash agreement establishes artifact identity, not scientific correctness or authenticated human/agent identity.
External trusted callbacks must genuinely validate execution traces, proof artifacts, source/checkpoint bindings, and verifier provenance; the scorer cannot authenticate those facts locally.
Pre-existing untracked verifier traces and unrelated staged NC-000 artifacts were present and were neither modified nor treated as evidence.
